understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem (+) by navigating horizontally through the tile grid and falling in the current gravity direction until landing on it.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the player horizontally, after which gravity automatically carries the player until landing on a solid tile, hitting a spike hazard, or reaching the goal. Gravity direction determines whether falling moves toward smaller or larger y values. CLICK removes a targeted clickable breakable block (x) without moving the player, and UNDO reverts the previous action. Safe supports can be landed on, while spikes cause immediate failure.
